method: Independent parser with original author car COCO JSON and fixed Git tree. Reconstructed metadata-only sampling, verified JPEG Git blobs and all stored hashes, compared every PNG pixel to its exact author-ROI crop, reconstructed normalized car labels, compared original 270 and dev18 files byte for byte, and resolved both YAML datasets against actual files.
label_tolerance: At most 0.51e-9 in normalized coordinates, matching 9-decimal serialization; original270/dev18 label checks additionally require exact bytes.
limitations: 747 images reuse the same 48 training dates; this increases frame diversity, not the number of independent training dates or sites.
The two rainy strata contain all 45 and 72 eligible images; missing quota was not filled with duplicates or evaluation dates.
Hash/pixel/label fidelity does not prove author annotations are error-free and does not establish model accuracy.
No model, training, validation inference or prediction-result inspection was performed by this audit.
